name: web-project-toolkit
description: Toolkit complet pour piloter un projet web de A à Z — 10 phases de la discovery au post-lancement

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Initialise le dossier work/ et le fichier projet.md central

plugins.name: 01-discovery
plugins.description: Phase Discovery : cadrage, audit, benchmark, UX, specs, charte éditoriale, RGPD

plugins.name: 02-business
plugins.description: Phase Business : business model, pricing, go-to-market, fundraising

plugins.name: 03-architecture
plugins.description: Phase Architecture : stack, hébergement, schéma, accessibilité, SEO

plugins.name: 04-setup
plugins.description: Phase Setup : repo, CI/CD, conventions, secrets, analytics, documentation IA

plugins.name: 05-design
plugins.description: Phase Design : wireframes, maquettes hi-fi, prototypage, review client, handoff

plugins.name: 06-ticketing
plugins.description: Phase Ticketing : DoD, épiques, tickets GitHub, estimation, priorisation

plugins.name: 07-development
plugins.description: Phase Dev : env local, Storybook, front, back, données, analytics, review

plugins.name: 08-qa
plugins.description: Phase QA : tests unitaires, E2E, cross-browser, a11y, sécurité, performance

plugins.name: 09-deployment
plugins.description: Phase Déploiement : staging, mise en prod, monitoring, redirections SEO

plugins.name: 10-post-launch
plugins.description: Phase Post-lancement : documentation, maintenance, rétro, analytics J+30, itérations
